method: numerical search of this atlas: orbit elimination with the rotation group A4 (code/cannon_tetra.py --start, code/simplex_cubature.py) started from the previous PI rule CA-T3-30-1506-PI written in A4-orbit form; proven with tools/verify_rigorous.py; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
